crons.comment: §5.4 fan-out safety net. DAILY, not minutely: Vercel Hobby caps crons at once per day and a more frequent expression will not run there. What each hit does is controlled by WORKER_MODE (continuous | weekly | off) — see docs/setup.md. Low-latency delivery does NOT depend on this: the Supabase Database Webhook and the opportunistic trigger in src/lib/notifications/trigger.ts both fire the moment an event is written.
§8 retention prune. Each run loops until the backlog is drained, so daily is ample — the tightest window is rate_events at 24h.
